dialogue.text: Yo, for a ghost who gets auto-deleted from everyone's memory, you got some serious pipes!
You really do sound wonderful, Ghost. There's so much emotion in your voice.
Oh... really? Thank you. I... I've never had anyone to sing with before.
This is the most fun I've had... maybe ever.
Dude, we gotta capture this! We could make a whole album! 'The Unforgettable Ghost!' It'd be sick!
PJ... what good is an 'Unforgettable' album... if everyone forgets the artist?
Oh... right. Shit. That really, really sucks.
That... that's the kindest thing anyone's ever offered me.
Even if it's impossible... it means everything that you wanted to.
So... before you go... can we sing one last song? A memory, just for us?
